description: The same unreadable overrides file, in a project that has marked nothing. A carrier answers for what a marked body calls, so with no mark anywhere nothing consults it and nothing of what the author wrote is being discarded — the silent no-op the refusal exists to prevent cannot happen here. So the linter says nothing, and `nothrow check` is what answers for the file regardless of marks. `overrides-not-json-refuses` is the same file one mark away, and it stops the run.
